WITH cust AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Segment FROM customers WHERE Currency='CZK'
),
per_cust AS (
  SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total2013
  FROM cust c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID=ym.CustomerID AND ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
minseg AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total2013) AS min_total
  FROM per_cust GROUP BY Segment
),
avglow AS (
  SELECT pc.Segment, AVG(pc.total2013) AS avg_low
  FROM per_cust pc
  JOIN minseg m ON pc.Segment=m.Segment AND pc.total2013=m.min_total
  GROUP BY pc.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_low FROM avglow WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT avg_low FROM avglow WHERE Segment='LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
  (SELECT avg_low FROM avglow WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT avg_low FROM avglow WHERE Segment='KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
  (SELECT avg_low FROM avglow WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT avg_low FROM avglow WHERE Segment='SME') AS KAM_minus_SME
